question: Should OpenClaw expose a configurable pre-timeout warning, and should that contract promise equivalent native and ACP steering behavior?
rationale: The missing capability and technical boundary are clear, but the new public configuration/tool surface and heterogeneous-runtime guarantee require maintainer intent.

options.title: Capability-aware warning
options.body: Add a documented grace setting and optional per-spawn override, using canonical lifecycle timers and reporting runtimes that cannot durably accept the warning.

options.title: Native-only warning
options.body: Ship the feature only for native sub-agents and reject or omit it for ACP until equivalent steering is proven.

options.title: No new warning surface
options.body: Retain prompt-based checkpointing and post-timeout recovery without adding configuration or tool parameters.

recommendation.title: Capability-aware warning
recommendation.body: Add a documented grace setting and optional per-spawn override, using canonical lifecycle timers and reporting runtimes that cannot durably accept the warning.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest verified cross-runtime history spanning native spawn, ACP spawn, and timeout/announce lifecycle behavior.
